title: SceneTree:initialize() takes up to a minute on release web export
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible on Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.official.f62fdbde1 - Build configuration: Emscripten 4.0.10, single-threaded, no GDExtension support. - Windows: - OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.0 (WebGL 2.0) - Compatibility - Using Device: Mozilla - ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980 Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0), or similar - OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.0 (WebGL 2.0 (OpenGL ES 3.0 Chromium)) - Compatibility - Using Device: WebKit - WebKit WebGL - Linux - OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.0 (WebGL 2.0) - Compatibility - Using Device: Mozilla - Intel(R) HD Graphics, or similar - OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.0 (WebGL 2.0 (OpenGL ES 3.0 Chromium)) - Compatibility - Using Device: WebKit - WebKit WebGL ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700H (14 threads) - 31.02 GiB memory ### Issue description Exported web release builds take a very long time to initialize (`SceneTree:initialize()`).. up to 30 seconds is spent compiling regexes.. (though this may be a red herring) see also: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/87843 https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/70691 ### Steps to reproduce Export a project for web with the release template? [web-opt-release-Trace-20260211T151159.json.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25247086/web-opt-release-Trace-20260211T151159.json.gz) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) wip
